```
export function copyAllMissing(): void {
  if (bulkCopyBusy) return;
  const destDir = focusedDestDir(); // same resolution as executeCopy
  if (!destDir) { setStatus("Survole d'abord un dossier à droite (Tab puis ↑↓)…"); return; }
  const pool = collectMissingVisible(); // {files, totalNouveau, filterTerm}
  // exclusions
  const twins = pool.files.filter(f => state.dupMatches.get(f.fullpath)?.sourceFullPath?.startsWith(`${destDir}/`));
  const files = pool.files.filter(...not twin...)
  if (!files.length) { setStatus(...); return; }
  const spec = buildCopyDialogSpec([{destName, destCreated: !destExists(destDir), filenames: files.map(f=>f.filename), destDir}], {styleConsent: styleConsentShort(destDir) ?? undefined, exclusions: exclusionLines});
  confirmCopyDialog(spec, async () => { bulkCopyBusy = true; ... const {copied, styleNote} = await copyFilesTo(destDir, files, progress); setStatus(...) });
}
```
